capabilities: Collect quotes into listings using a tag and author syntax
Embed quote blocks via localquote code blocks with id and search parameters
Refresh quotes automatically on intervals from seconds to years
Create quote blocks with the Quote Maker and One-Time Quote Maker modals
View quote statistics via a command
disambiguation: Not a Markdown blockquote formatter; it manages collections of quotable text and embeds auto-refreshing quote blocks.
extras: The README states the plugin is in maintenance mode: all planned features are implemented, so no new features will be added, though bug fixes continue. Some documentation is on separate linked pages rather than in the README.
motivation: The author wanted an index note that displays a new quote every day automatically from quote lists they had written themselves.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to gather quotes scattered across notes and display them in notes with automatic rotation over time.

relations.evidence: Stylize the refresh button's corner, size, and padding in the "Style Settings" plugin.

summary: Quote manager that collects quotes from tagged notes across the vault and embeds rotating quote blocks that refresh on set intervals.
